capacity_scaling.criterion: at approximately fixed active unique parameters (within 5% of the smallest rung), fit log(cold bytes per token) against log(total accessible capacity); the slope's 95% CI upper bound must be below 1

discrimination.binding_required: a receipt naming the pair fixture's sha256, the mutation rule and the scoring rule; until then the endpoint is registered and unusable
discrimination.endpoint: candidate-ranking accuracy: the fraction of registered pairs in which the model assigns a higher likelihood to the correct candidate than to a mutated one
discrimination.never_pooled_with: the absolute primary endpoint, and never pooled across categories
discrimination.why: no pair fixture exists and no receipt binds one, so no discrimination number may be reported

no_hidden_teacher.criterion: teacher_calls_at_inference == 0 and a replay-court receipt (P7.5) is named; an external adapter that cannot expose this is recorded as unverified, never as satisfied

physical_pareto.criterion: no control row may dominate the arm on success, cold bytes per token, p95 latency and residency simultaneously

3B-8B quantised local baseline.reason: no such checkpoint is present locally; a row is emitted with unavailable fields and a reason, never a fabricated number

bootstrap.kind: paired percentile, items resampled within category, categories weighted equally

primary.decision_rule: WIN iff the paired 95% CI lower bound is at or above the minimum absolute effect. Per-category regressions beyond 0.05 absolute are reported and block a transfer claim; they are not a conjunct of the primary, because the conjunct is measured to cost about a quarter of the decision power at the same effect.
primary.definition: equal weight per category; the arithmetic mean inside each category; categories are reported separately and never pooled
primary.endpoint: category-balanced mean verified task success on the 144-task suite

minimum_absolute_effect_source.derivation: ceil(max(planning MDE, conservative MDE) at the registered n to the next 0.01); the conservative variance is the one that must be reachable, so the minimum is set from it

primary.reporting: every category is reported separately; per-category regressions beyond the registered margin are disclosed and block a transfer claim; the absolute endpoint and the discrimination endpoint are never pooled, and neither is pooled across categories

sealed_holdback.policy: Frozen before any arm run. Never used for tuning, prompt selection, few-shot examples, checkpoint selection or threshold selection. Scored once per revision, only with the unlock flag and the registered sealed hash, and reported once with its unlock record.

supersedes.reason: the 10%-relative endpoint cannot be resolved at any feasible item count on this instrument; the endpoint becomes an absolute effect whose minimum is derived from the measured variance at the registered n

trio.rule: a transfer claim requires success on every surface (rust, numeric-graph, logic) with the per-surface breakdown reported; results are never pooled across surfaces
